$comment: Safari-only overrides merged over vendor/hister/webui/ext/dist/manifest.json by scripts/patch-manifest.mjs. Keys starting with $ are dropped, null deletes a key, objects merge recursively, arrays and scalars replace whole.
name: Shiori
description: Sends the pages you visit to your own Hister server.
$comment_permissions: Upstream also asks for 'cookies', which only serves 'Authenticate with Browser Session'. Shiori talks to a token-less server gated by the network, so it is dropped. nativeMessaging reads the app's combined-search setting. scripts/build-extension.sh fails if upstream adds a permission this list does not account for.
$comment_content_scripts: Upstream's content script (build-extension.sh checks it is unchanged), plus Shiori's combined-search redirect on duckduckgo.com.
$comment_options: Shiori's settings page in place of upstream's (server, token, headers, browser-session sign-in: the app sets the server, and the rest has no use here).
$comment_commands: Safari does apply suggested_key (it showed upstream's as ⇧⌘I/B/Y, and ⇧⌘Y is macOS's New Sticky Note). So all of Shiori's are Control-Shift, which Safari and macOS leave free; the user can change them in Safari → Settings → Extensions. _execute_action is the toolbar button's menu, with no default key: more than four suggested shortcuts and Safari drops the background silently (it broke Safari's search; build-extension.sh checks). iOS has none.
$comment_war: Upstream exposes assets/* to no page (empty matches), which Safari rejects. Nothing in the content script loads extension files, so drop the key rather than widen it: exposing assets to every page lets any site detect the extension.
